description: 3-phase reactive power controller (capacitor bank), Modbus RTU. All registers 32-bit (stride +2). Common data 0-26 (avg V/I, total P/Q/S, avg cosΦ/PF, L-L voltages 1-2/2-3/3-1/avg, neutral I, total THDV/THDI, f32 RO). Per-phase data 28-150 / 152-274 / 276-398: basic (V,I,P,Q,S,cosΦ,PF,freq,THDV,THDI f32) + V harmonics 1,3,...,51 and I harmonics 1,3,...,51 (all f32 RO). Alarm flags at 400 (first 32bits) and 402 (second 32bits, u32 RO). Step variables 404-456: active/available/fixed step flags + switching counts + operation times (u32 RO) for 12 capacitor steps. Tariff meters 458-512 (active/reactive import/export kWh/kVArh, current/last hour/day/month, f32 RO). Demand 514-576 (total+per-phase P/Q/S/I demand values + timestamps, f32/u32 RO). Other 578-582: temperature/battery/time. Alarm log 584-982: 50 events (4 registers each: timestamp u32, ID u32, state u32, value f32). History file numbers 984-988. Step estimated powers 990-1012 (DCM option, f32). Config 2000-2312: network (CTR/VTR/demand period), energy tariff T1 counters, bank (12 steps power/type, bank power/count/discharge), compensation (steps/program/targets/timing/angle), comms (baud/slave), alarm limits for V-LN/V-LL/I/P/Q/S/IN/PF/cosΦ/freq/temp/V-harmonics/I-harmonics/inductive+capacitive energy, auxiliary, learn, device (language/contrast/password/display/serial). Clear commands 1898-1916 (WO). Save 1998 (WO, write 1 to commit config to flash).

| Klemsan RAPIDUS Reactive Power Controller — Modbus RTU Register Map
| Product: RAPIDUS — automatic reactive power controller / capacitor bank controller
| FC03 (0x03) — Read Holding Registers (read all parameters)
| FC10 (0x10) — Write Multiple Registers (write config + clear commands)
| FC14 (0x14) — Read File Record (history archive; file numbers in registers 984/986/988)
| Data types: 32-bit registers (all stride +2); f32 = IEEE 754 float; u32 = 32-bit signed int
| (Rapidus calls it "int = 32-bit işaretli tam sayı, little-endian b0,b1,b2,b3")
| Unix timestamps stored as u32 (seconds since epoch).
| Save config changes: write 1 to register 1998 within 60 s of last write.
| History archive (FC14): hourly files 1-1920, daily 5001-5240, monthly 10001-10036.
